statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled meeting concluding on 2026-12-09.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement released on 2026-12-09 announces a higher target range, equivalently FRED series DFEDTARU for 2026-12-10 exceeds its 2026-12-08 value; FALSE if the range is held or cut.
failure_condition: The FOMC held or lowered the federal funds target range at the meeting concluding on 2026-12-09, or announced no decision that day.

control_basis.rule: climatological, trailing - the realized hit rate of the mirrored arm's own resolved rows, by the first step of the ladder with at least 10 rows (registration v4, Section 3)
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. The floor the mirrored arm must clear, priced from its own record; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: WTI crude (FRED series DCOILWTICO) records a daily value below 90.00 dollars per barrel on at least one day between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31. Reference: WTI 102.60 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any DCOILWTICO daily observation dated 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31, as published on FRED at the deadline, is below 90.00; FALSE otherwise. Reference: 102.60 dollars per barrel at seal.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO daily value from 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31 was at or above 90.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: CISA adds at least one Oracle E-Business Suite vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-28 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed, fetched on the deadline, holds an entry with vendorProject Oracle, product E-Business Suite, and dateAdded from 2026-10-28 through 2026-12-11 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: CISA did not add any Oracle E-Business Suite vulnerability to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-28 and 2026-12-11.

statement: A University of New Mexico health entity submits a HIPAA breach report to the HHS Office for Civil Rights with a breach submission date between 2026-10-28 and 2027-01-08.
resolution: TRUE if the HHS OCR breach portal, checked on the deadline, lists a covered entity whose name contains UNM or University of New Mexico with a breach submission date between 2026-10-28 and 2027-01-08; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No University of New Mexico health entity had a HIPAA breach report with a submission date between 2026-10-28 and 2027-01-08 on file and publicly posted by HHS OCR by 2027-01-15.
